title: Sparse Functional Write Assemblies under Superposition

parent_experiment.rule: 002B is a new pre-registered mechanism test. It must not alter, relabel, or retroactively rescue the frozen 002 v1 decision.

hypothesis: A learned functional atom under superposition may be represented by a small sparse latent assembly rather than a single latent coordinate. A non-oracle rank-1 sparse write address with width r <= 8 should substantially improve update fidelity while preserving locality, and should outperform a full-writer baseline at matched update success.

scope.primary_claim: This tests whether the relevant writable mathematical object is a small sparse functional assembly rather than one neuron/latent index.

world.observation_equation: x = A s with fixed dense column-normalized Gaussian A

model.candidate: same top-k sparse functional encoder + linear writer as Core Validation 002

pretraining.note: 002B intentionally keeps the 002 sparse pretraining architecture/objective fixed so address-width effects are identifiable.

legacy_global_write.role: configuration compatibility only; not the decisive 002B global baseline

sparse_address.factorization: Delta W = delta a^T with ||a||_0 <= r
sparse_address.inference: Compute residual R from the 8 edit examples only; extract its dominant sample-space singular direction; use deterministic OMP on frozen learned z to select a support; refine a and delta by alternating least squares on that support.
sparse_address.write_rule: Only writer parameters on the inferred sparse support change; encoder and reconstructor remain frozen.

matched_global.equation: Delta W^T = scale * Z^T (Z Z^T + lambda I)^(-1) R
matched_global.matching_rule: For each formal seed, match the best sparse-width candidate to the pre-registered global curve point with nearest sequence-level median U. No-op or badly unmatched global points cannot establish locality superiority.
matched_global.reason: Core Validation 002's SGD global writer had median U about 0.83, so its very small leakage was not a valid matched-success locality comparator.

evaluation.assembly_fit_error: Evaluator-only best linear reconstruction error of true target coefficient s_j from h = z^T a on unseen affected combinations.
evaluation.oracle_latent_reference: Use evaluator-only z=s with exact target-column writes; expected U approximately 0 and L approximately 0.
evaluation.retention: After each edit, evaluate retained probes from earlier edits against current evaluator V; probes are never optimized on.

interpretation_limits: A positive result does not overturn Core Validation 002; it supports a different hypothesis in which a write address is a sparse functional subspace rather than one latent coordinate.
The Gaussian additive world remains intentionally favorable and is not evidence for language-scale continual learning.
Dense and MoE models are contextual controls and cannot veto the sparse mechanism gate.
Ground-truth geometry diagnostics are evaluator-only and may not influence address inference or writes.
Failure in this favorable regime is evidence against the frozen rank-1 sparse-assembly mechanism with r <= 8, not against every possible continual-learning architecture.
Thresholds and scales are frozen before the three formal seeds are run and must not be changed after observing formal results.
